Medium blue, like a clear sky over a quiet valley. Made from soft, lightweight woven denim in a classic medium wash, these wide-leg trousers offer breathable comfort and a fluid drape. They have an elasticated waistband with a denim drawstring, curved front scoop pockets, and clean wide-open hems. Pair with a white crew-neck tee and clean white leather sneakers, or layer with an oversized fleece sweatshirt or a sweatshirt for a relaxed look. 

Care Instructions:
● Machine or hand wash up to 30°C/86°F
● Gentle cycle
● Do not dry in direct sunlight
● Do not bleach
● Do not iron directly on prints/embroidery

changes.title: Women Suit
changes.detail: Description changed (see changes.json for full before/after)
changes.before:
Care Instructions:
● Machine or hand-wash up to 30°C/86°F
● Gentle cycle
● Do not dry in direct sunlight
● Do not bleach
● Do not iron directly on prints/embroidery
changes.after:
Black as the hour before the stars, and just as comforting. Made from soft, brushed fleece with a fluid drape, this two-piece tracksuit offers cozy warmth and a relaxed, easy look. The pullover sweatshirt features a fold-over collar, a quarter-zip placket with subtle V-stitched detail, elasticated cuffs, and a gathered hem. The matching wide-leg trousers have an elasticated waist, side pockets, and open hems. Wear together with beige ballet flats and a cream crossbody bag, or style each piece separately with a white T-shirt and tailored outerwear for a relaxed look. 

Care Instructions:
● Machine or hand-wash up to 30°C/86°F
● Gentle cycle
● Line dry or tumble dry low; do not dry in direct sunlight
● Do not bleach
● Do not iron

Crafted from soft, velvety suede fabric with a smooth finish, this bomber jacket offers a smooth feel and a relaxed everyday look. It has a sharp fold-over collar, a full-length zip placket, button-flap welt pockets at the waist, and ribbed knit cuffs and hem. Layer it over a white tee or a lightweight knit with straight-fit trousers or dark denim and clean leather sneakers, or wear it on its own for a relaxed look.

● Hand-wash or spot clean at up to 30°C/86°F
● Gentle handling; do not rub
● Air dry away from heat and direct sunlight; do not tumble dry 
● Do not bleach
● Do not iron

changes.title: Boys Bomber Jacket
changes.detail: Description changed (see changes.json for full before/after)
changes.after:
Soft ridges and a snap-front closure, ready for the walk to school. Crafted from durable corduroy with fine vertical ribs, this bomber jacket offers cosy warmth and a relaxed everyday fit for ages 7 to 14. It has a classic fold-over collar, a hidden snap-button front with matte snap buttons, angled side welt pockets, and an elasticated hem and cuffs for a neat, gathered shape. Layer it over a rust-brown quarter-zip pullover and matching wide-leg trousers with tan suede boots, or pair it with a plain tee and denim for a relaxed look.

Care Instructions:
● Machine or hand-wash at up to 30°C/86°F; inside out
● Gentle cycle
● Do not dry in direct sunlight
● Do not bleach
● Iron with medium heat on the reverse side only

changes.title: Women Blazer
changes.detail: Description changed (see changes.json for full before/after)
changes.after:
Shadow and snow, woven side by side. Cut from textured woven wool in a classic check plaid, this structured blazer offers cozy seasonal warmth and a relaxed drape. It has a smooth contrast collar, a concealed full-zip placket, and two front patch pockets that open at a neat, welted top edge, with cuffs and hem that are clean and straight. Pair it with a black button-front midi skirt or tailored trousers, a dark brown leather handbag, and minimal loafers for a polished, easy look. 

Care Instructions:
● Hand-wash up to 30°C/86°F
● Gentle cycle
● Do not dry in direct sunlight
● Do not bleach
● Use gentle steam only; do not iron
